title: VIC, NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned works on access network equipment in parts of Victoria and New South Wales are scheduled for Monday 19 October, 12:00 AM–6:00 AM AEDT. Some customers may experience a brief loss of connection during this window, with one short interruption of up to 15 minutes currently scheduled around 1:00 AM AEDT. Our team will monitor progress and provide updates. Services are expected to be fully restored by 6:00 AM AEDT.

updates.content: We will be performing planned maintenance affecting some services in parts of Victoria and New South Wales. The maintenance window is Monday 19 October, 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT. A brief loss of connection (up to 15 minutes) is expected around 1:00 AM AEDT. We will monitor throughout and share updates. If you need to stay online during the brief interruption, consider using mobile data where available. Thank you for your patience.
